preconditions.description: The length of string t is a positive integer up to 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(t) == n and all(c in {'0', '1'} for c in t)
preconditions.description: The string t has length n and consists only of '0's and '1's.
The number of queries q is a positive integer up to 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l1 <= n and 1 <= l2 <= n and 1 <= length <= n - max(l1, l2) + 1 and all(isinstance(x, int) for x in (l1, l2, length)) for l1, l2, length in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query consists of three integers l1, l2, and length, where 1 ≤ l1, l2 ≤ n, 1 ≤ length ≤ n - max(l1, l2) + 1.

postconditions.expression: all(output_line.strip().upper() in {'YES', 'NO'} for output_line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line of output is either 'YES' or 'NO' (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((s1 := t[l1-1:l1+length-1], s2 := t[l2-1:l2+length-1], is_reachable(s1, s2)) == (output_line.strip().upper() == 'YES') for (l1, l2, length), output_line in zip(queries, stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: For each query (l1, l2, length), the output is 'YES' if and only if the substring t[l1...l1+length-1] is reachable from t[l2...l2+length-1] using the allowed operations.
